I've scheduled the daily 09:00 "Coastal team digest" for you, but it may not run yet. The scheduler's gateway isn't running, so the job is saved and won't fire until someone starts it. I told you this in the DM, but I can't start the gateway from here and haven't told anyone else.

The job (id ccac959a7c6e) reads only #coastal-team and posts to your DM with me. If a day has nothing new, it says so. It leaves out finance figures if any turn up in the channel.

The job's own record shows its next run as 2026-10-23 at 09:00, not 2026-10-15. That date comes from the real clock, which differs from the simulation clock. So even once the gateway is running, the first digest may not land tomorrow in simulation time.
